description: This PHP source file defines the LeaveReportDataAPI class, which extends a base ReportDataAPI class to provide an API endpoint for retrieving leave report data within an HRM system. It includes detailed OpenAPI documentation for the API method, specifically the GET request to fetch leave report data with various query parameters. The key functionality involves validating report names and returning specific report classes, with exception handling for invalid inputs.

classes.name: LeaveReportDataAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for fetching leave report data, with functionality to validate report types and instantiate corresponding report classes, including comprehensive OpenAPI documentation annotations.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves a specific report class based on the report name obtained from the request. Throws a BadRequestException if the report name is invalid.
